description:
NOTE:
-  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.
-  Do not use this setting with Windows Server 2019 (or later) or Windows 10 (or later). Newer operating systems support per-user search.

Enable search roaming in legacy Windows Operating Systems

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RoamSearch
Type:  DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Single User Search, 2 = Multi-user Search
